export function parseUri(uri: string): { type: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = uri.match(/^repo:\/\/([a-zA-Z]+)(?:\/(.*)?)?$/);
  if (!match) return null;
  return { type: match[1], path: match[2] ? decodeURIComponent(match[2]) : "" };
}
```
